eng.traineddata.gz: test fixture only (not shipped with the app).
Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@tesseract.js-data/eng/4.0.0_best_int/eng.traineddata.gz
(@tesseract.js-data/eng, MIT; the data originates from tesseract-ocr/tessdata, Apache-2.0).
Used by e2e/r2c.spec.ts, served by the mock server to test the OCR download + recognition path offline.
